# forumulate_space_settings (Resource)

The settings doors of one space, in one resource per space: its layout (`preset`, `piece_preset`, `front_door_json`), `seo_json`, `theme_json`, the redirect table, and the type's own settings (`blog_settings_json`, `forum_settings_json`, `status_settings_json`). Each part is optional and only the parts you declare are managed.

Every JSON part is sent as a PATCH, so it merges into what is stored and a key you remove from the configuration is cleared. Drift is detected for the keys you declare; settings someone else manages are left alone. `redirects` replaces the operator-managed redirect table (rules the platform wrote itself on a rename are kept).

Destroying the resource resets what it declared: the JSON parts' keys (and the front door's) are cleared and the redirect table emptied. The layout names (`preset`, `piece_preset`) have no reset and stay as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_space_settings" "docs" {
  space_id = forumulate_space.docs.id

  preset = "standard"

  seo_json = jsonencode({
    seoTitle       = "Acme documentation"
    description    = "How to build with Acme."
    siteName       = "Acme"
    titleTemplate  = "{title} | Acme Docs"
    socialImageUrl = "https://acme.example/og.png"
  })

  theme_json = jsonencode({
    primaryColor = "#0b835b"
    accentColor  = "#f59e0b"
  })

  redirects = [
    { from = "/docs/start", to = "/docs/getting-started", status = 301 },
    { from = "/old/*", to = "/new/*" },
  ]
}

# A blog's own settings live in the same resource.
resource "forumulate_space_settings" "blog" {
  space_id = forumulate_space.blog.id

  blog_settings_json = jsonencode({
    whoCanPost       = "members"
    moderateComments = true
    commentOrder     = "newest"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) The space (its id or slug). Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `blog_settings_json` (String) A BLOG space's settings: `whoCanPost`, `moderateComments`, `commentOrder`, `defaultByline`, `federation`, ... A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.
- `forum_settings_json` (String) A FORUM space's community settings: `whoCanPost`, `moderateComments`, `postVotes`, `pinScope`, `reactionEmojis`, ... A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.
- `front_door_json` (String) The front door's switches and heading (`title`, `showFacts`, ...); the keys each type accepts are in `GET /space-types/{type}/presets` under `frontDoor`. A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.
- `piece_preset` (String) The layout of a piece's own page (a post, a topic); validated against the type (`piecePresets`).
- `preset` (String) The named layout the reader wears; validated by the API against the space's type (`GET /space-types/{type}/presets`).
- `redirects` (Attributes List) The space's redirect table (up to 500 rules). Replaced whole; platform-written rename redirects are kept. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--redirects))
- `seo_json` (String) The space's SEO: `seoTitle`, `description`, `siteName`, `titleTemplate`, `socialImageUrl`, `socialCard`, `twitterSite`, `verification`, `noindex`, `metatags`, `pages`, ... A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.
- `status_settings_json` (String) A STATUS space's page settings: `autoIncident`, `notifySubscribers`, `alertChannels`, `dayThresholds`, `smsTemplate`, ... A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.
- `theme_json` (String) The space's theme: colours, fonts, `components`, `chrome`, `motion`, `mobile`, ... Colour tokens are six-digit hex with the leading #. A key the theme does not have is refused by name. A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The space's id.

<a id="nestedatt--redirects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redirects`

Required:

- `from` (String) The old path, starting with a single `/`; a trailing `*` matches any suffix.
- `to` (String) The new path, or an https URL (a redirect only; a rewrite names a path).

Optional:

- `pass_query` (Boolean) Carry the incoming query string to the target.
- `status` (Number) The redirect's HTTP status: 301, 302, 307 or 308 (the default). Ignored by a rewrite.
- `type` (String) `redirect` (the default) sends the reader on; `rewrite` serves `to` at the requested address.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# By the space's slug (or its id). Declare the parts you want managed first.
terraform import forumulate_space_settings.docs docs
```
